question: Which additional occasions complete the schedule for bathing the liṅga?
premises: Noon is named as a ritual occasion.
The last watch of the day is named.
The conclusion of the great worship is named.
inference: Bathing is also to be performed at noon, in the last watch, and at the conclusion of the great worship.
uncertainties: This verse continues the injunction from the previous verse without repeating the verb.
plain_english: At noon, in the last watch of the day, and at the conclusion of the great worship.
